fields.label: Location
fields.note: From the company's Workable board; the Webflow careers page only exposes a name search.

notes: The official careers page is a Webflow listing: 3 rendered cards with Location/Type/Department labels and a client-side search input (name=job-search, r-filter=name). The company's Workable account richpanel-1 publishes the full board (12 open roles at apply.workable.com/richpanel-1/jobs.md, Last updated 2026-11-09), and the adapter unions the page cards with that board. The page uses no filter query parameters, so filtering is local.
